# Fixture structure index

## Pages
- `long-read` — pages/long-read.md — one argument read top to bottom
- `tile-field` — pages/tile-field.md — mixed-size tiles
- `letter` — pages/letter.md — a first-person note
- `catalogue` — pages/catalogue.md — an inventory to browse
- `workbench` — pages/workbench.md — the working surface is the page

## Parts
- `headline-only` (hero) — parts/heroes.md — type alone
- `split-pair` (hero) — parts/heroes.md — two halves
- `minimal-pair` (nav) — parts/navs.md — wordmark and two links
- `side-rail` (nav) — parts/navs.md — vertical rail
- `single-line` (footer) — parts/footers.md — one line
- `category-index` (footer) — parts/footers.md — grouped links
